text:
No qualifying tree-cover loss has been detected since 2021.

- The only post-baseline loss is 0.4 ha in 2021, in patches under the 0.5 ha minimum event size. These aren't counted as events.
- The data is complete through 2025: Hansen has full valid-data coverage, and annual observations run to 2025.
- The large losses (67.7 ha in 2020, 25.5 ha in 2015, 4.8 ha in 2017, 0.8 ha in 2008) all happened before the 31 Dec 2020 baseline, so they don't answer your question.
- Little tree cover is left to lose. The asset (2,843 ha) had only 23 ha of tree cover in 2000, and the JRC reference shows 0 ha of forest in 2020.

Caveat: Hansen data has 30 m resolution, so very small or gradual losses may be missed. The tool is also an early-access version. The 2021 MGAP source was unavailable, but this doesn't change the Hansen result.
